title: Sonic Adventure
text:
Sonic Adventure is a platform game developed by Sonic Team, published by Sega, and initially released for the Sega Dreamcast in 1998 in Japan by Sega for the Sega Dreamcast. It is the first major 3D platform game in the Sonic the Hedgehog series.

The game was ported to the Nintendo GameCube in 2004 as Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut, which served as the basis for its ports for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows.

 Story 
Dr. Robotnik, or Dr. Eggman, releases the ancient being Chaos from the Master Emerald, and plans to give it the Chaos Emeralds to make it become stronger and help him conquer the world and create Robotnikland. Sonic the Hedgehog, Miles "Tails" Prower, Knuckles the Echidna, Amy Rose, Big the Cat, and Eggman robot E-102 Gamma get caught up in this scheme, either trying to stop Eggman or pursuing their own goals.

 Gameplay 
Sonic Adventure features six playable characters, each with their own campaign. Each one has their differences in gameplay and different goals in Action Stages, which feature the main gameplay. Once all six campaigns are completed, a final campaign is unlocked that concludes the story.

Between Action Stages, players will explore three different Adventure Fields to progress the story, discover new Action Stages, find character-specific upgrades, and solve puzzles.
